title: Mahendra Varma
desc: A woman gets murdered in front of her young daughter by an unknown man. Police inspector Ashok joins forces with his friend, who is blind, to investigate the case and tries to nab the culprit.

title: Mugilpete
desc: Raja and Apoorva fall head-over-heels for one another, but must overcome their families' opposing views on love. Things come to a head when Apoorva goes missing and Raja sets out to track her down.

title: RX Soori
desc: A dreaded criminal, Paritaala Soori, terrorises the Rayalaseema province of Andhra Pradesh with his unlawful activities. Things take a turn when he falls in love with his childhood friend.

title: Elumale
desc: A chance encounter near the Tamil Nadu-Karnataka border in 2004 plunges a cab driver and a young woman into a tense night filled with lurking threats.

title: Hostel Hudugaru Bekagiddare
desc: A group of students who are suspects of a boy's hostel warden's death, make a plan to hide his corpse after they find a note left by him.
